description: This file defines the LogNode interface which specifies a contract for logging targets within an Android application. It includes a method for printing log data to the next node in a chain, supporting extensible logging chains.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a logging target in a chain of log nodes which can output log messages and pass them along.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to instruct the LogNode to output a log message, including severity, tag, message, and optional Throwable for exceptions.
